title: Notice Periods and Rate Increase Limits under the Memory Care Residency Agreement
content:
The periods below are written into every Memory Care Residency Agreement. All periods are calendar days; the increase ceiling is a percentage of the monthly rate.

## Rate increases

| Tier | Minimum written notice before a monthly rate increase (days) | Ceiling on a single annual increase (percent) |
|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | 60 | 8.5 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | 60 | 8.5 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | 60 | 8.5 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | 60 | 8.5 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | 60 | 8.5 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | 60 | 8.5 |

## Ending the residency

| Tier | Length of the written notice of termination (days) | Days after the date of death through which the monthly rate continues, unless belongings are removed later | Length of the written discharge notice (days) | Days a charge may remain past due before a discharge notice for nonpayment may be issued | Days after the vacate date by which the final statement is issued and any credit balance refunded |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | 30 | 7 | 30 | 45 | 30 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | 30 | 7 | 30 | 45 | 30 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | 30 | 7 | 30 | 45 | 30 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | 30 | 7 | 30 | 45 | 30 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | 30 | 7 | 30 | 45 | 30 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | 30 | 7 | 30 | 45 | 30 |

Every period is the same on all six tiers: 60 days of rate increase notice with an 8.5 percent ceiling, a 30-day notice of termination, 7 days after a death, a 30-day discharge notice, 45 days past due before a nonpayment discharge notice may be issued, and a final statement within 30 days of the vacate date.
